text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"UNSUPPORTED","reason":"Absence claims are only supported if they merely say the documents don't state something; this one also asserts how the documents describe the launch (as planned or targeted), which is an added factual assertion made without cited evidence."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Project Overview Document's Key Details lists 'Planned Launch Date: March 15, 2027', matching the claim."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown's timeline table lists 'Public launch | March 15, 2027', matching the claim."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Team & Governance Document states the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027 after the January 20, 2027 steering committee meeting."},{"claim_index":4,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"A neutral topic label that asserts no fact."},{"claim_index":5,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The sentence only says the documents don't state whether launch has happened, adding no other fact."}]}
